title: 箱梁推出与尚未接触的前方桥墩
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. G04-C bridge textbook contextual artwork, landscape3:2.
Input image1 is a geometrically checked reference, not a style reference. Preserve its whole ordinary bridge at the same construction stage, and produce a restrained textbook PEN AND WATERCOLOR illustration: precise fine warm-gray pen contours, pale gray concrete washes, rusty orange steel launching nose, very light ochre ground indications that fade into unpainted ivory paper. This is an engineering illustration, not a comic or an epic landscape. Clean oblique side view, complete structural silhouette, airy composition.
Geometry is a declared teaching assumption in metres, not a real project: continuous concrete box girder x=-45..110, width12, depth2.5, deck elevation15 above ground. Existing support bearings at x=0,45,90. Fourth future pier at135. Twin tapered longitudinal steel nose girders firmly connected at concrete front110, extending to130, exactly20m long; a5m gap remains to next pier. Preserve all ratios of the reference; uniform overall scale, no stylized shortening of deck or enlargement of piers. Show the three supporting contacts and the detached future pier clearly. Retain cross bracing between the two orange steel beams. No cars or people.
This is a contextual image only, different from F19's numerical model, not a dimensioned drawing or proof of construction feasibility. No writing inside image. No labels, dimension marks, numbers, formulas, force arrows, symbols, fake stress clouds, watermarks or logos. Do not merge into suspension bridge, do not invent an extra support, do not close the nose-to-pier gap, do not float disconnected structure. Distinct hand-drawn pen-and-wash finish rather than3D CGI.

limitations: 为新教学情境，与F19原计算模型不同；导梁/支座/台座连接均未作承载或施工验算。
